sentences.text:
Bench: Sudhanshu Dhulia
Wpms No.69 of 2015
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Shashikant Shandilya, Advocate present for the petitioner.
Mr. R.C. Arya, Standing Counsel has accepted notices on behalf of all the respondents.
Under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the Adjudicating Officer has imposed a penalty of Rs.1.00 lakh against the petitioner.

According to the petitioner, against the order of the Adjudicating Officer, there lies an appeal in the appellate court; however, the appellate tribunal has not been established in the State of Uttarakhand.
Counter affidavit be filed by the respondents within three weeks.
List this matter after four weeks in daily cause list.

Meanwhile, if petitioner deposits the penalty amount of Rs.1.00 lakh before Adjudicating Officer,
Haridwar/respondent No.3 within 10 days from today, further action will not be taken against the petitioner.

However, it is made clear that Adjudicating Officer, Haridwar shall deposit the penalty amount in a separate account preferably in a fixed deposit so that it may earn interest during the pendency of the matter.
What has to be done with this amount ultimately, shall depend upon final determination of the matter.
(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 14.01.2015 JKJ Samsher Gani vs State Of Uttarakhand & Others on 14 January, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145599180/
